description: List a folder. Default: one line per item, NAME TAB TYPE (file, dir, link). "long": true adds SIZE (bytes, files only), MTIME and INFO (folders: children N and aos files inside such as _entry, _tooldef.json, loop.json: then it is a tool or agent; files: exec, and the top keys of a .json file; links: -> target). "json": true returns everything as JSON instead. Folders first; names starting with . are hidden unless hidden is true. At most max_items per call; a last line "... next_offset N" means more: call again with offset N. Then use stat, view or read on one item. Errors: FileMissing, FileBad.

path.description: the folder, relative to your workspace or absolute (default .)

max_items.description: most items to show (default 100, at most 500)

hidden.description: true = also list names starting with .

long.description: true = add the columns SIZE MTIME INFO

json.description: true = everything as one JSON object (path, counter_items, items with all details, next_offset, counter_hidden)
